notes.engine: Apple Vision is the default on macOS; PaddleOCR and Tesseract are optional alternatives.
notes.language_routing: Traditional Chinese account labels use zh-Hant; Portuguese uses an available pt-* locale; amount columns use English/digit recognition.
notes.raw_policy: Raw OCR text and source images are immutable evidence; normalized labels and amounts are stored separately.
notes.number_policy: Infer comma_dot or dot_comma from each statement's numeric evidence, not from Chinese/Portuguese language. Recovered OCR separators are sent to review.
notes.config_file: Reference example only; the current CLI reads command-line options, not this JSON file.
